rail.definition: Goods transported by railway are the volume of goods transported by railway, measured in metric tons times kilometers traveled.
rail.sourceOrganizations:
Railisa Database (UIC), International Union of Railways (UIC), uri: https://uic-stats.uic.org/select/;
OECD Statistics, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
rail.geographies: World Bank country/economy registry entries outside its Aggregates region, with at least one numeric observation.
rail.unit: Million metric tonnes × kilometers of railway transport.

housing.definition: Share of the market-price tenant population living in households where total housing costs exceed 40% of disposable household income, after subtracting housing allowances from both quantities. Housing costs include eligible utilities and charges.
housing.unit: Percent of people in market-price tenant households. A difference between two years uses percentage points.
housing.coverage: European reporting countries; Eurostat EU and euro-area aggregates are excluded. The World Bank country registry links Eurostat EL to GRC and UK to GBR; Kosovo retains source code XK and map key XKX.

coverage: Only countries with at least one observation in a series appear. Within each series-wide span, all annual positions are present, with null/blank for missing observations. Break and provisional flags remain attached to their source years.

validation.method: Each published value, missing year and source status checked against an independent official export (WDI bulk CSV and Eurostat bulk TSV).
